answer: Canary audits give each fake key its own trap. Each epoch the protocol plants one quartz, a canary prompt unique to that key, among every 10 seats in the orchard of open assignments. A key whose reply shares over 30% of its words with a copied template burns its 40 POA jade bond. Each key meets those 10% odds alone, so a farm cannot pool the loss. 1,000 fakes x 10% x 40 POA = 4,000 POA burned per epoch. Attacker pays 4,000 POA.
